propositions: The complexity baseline file lacks a CI lock equivalent to the module-size limit lock, allowing any contributor to modify it without administrative review
The baseline can grow silently by adding new entries: a function at high complexity can be admitted by adding a matching baseline entry, bypassing the ratchet
CI must enforce a semantic (not byte-equality) lock that rejects raised ceilings or new entries while allowing removed entries and lowered ceilings to pass
The module-size limit's lock fails open when the base fetch fails, allowing unverified limits from the branch to be applied; both locks must fail closed instead
Adding a function above the C901 threshold must fail CI even when a baseline entry is added in the same change
